intent: classify source-only factorization under the actual admission predicate before claiming a role-domain obstruction
fixed_policy: The current source-bound instance admits Root values a with a = actual. Its target selection must factor through any forgetful map by constant reconstruction from the globally supplied actual input.
independent_policy: For an independently admitted product S times T with inhabited S, projection to T factors through projection to S exactly when a target t0 is equal to every allowed target. Distinct Boolean completions give an obstruction; they are an abstract contrasting policy, not claimed actual role packets.

boundary: No claim that the actual fixed input supplies two distinct admissible completions. A factorization with a target baked into its environment is not a source-generated native role action.
stop_condition: Fresh safe Cubical positive/hostile checks and live source pins, or the first mismatch in the actual admission predicate.
